note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 19, NIC 53, Execute Decree 31/2012 112, 125; A06b Const 19, NIC 53, Execute Decree 31/2012 112, 125; L05 Const 20, NIC 47, 64): ordinary naturalisation after 4 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships (with major exceptions); a citizen keeps it on taking another (loss applies only to naturalised citizens, not modelled). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Nicaragua, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Nicaragua for a continuous period of 4 years since being granted a permanent resident permit. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required (except if person is a national by birth of Spain or a Central American country (see A18). ... Person is a citizen by naturalisation who voluntarily acquires citizenship of another country.
